#Region "Main"
Excel.LaunchExcel Visible: True LoadAddIns: False
    Excel.GetFirstFreeRowOnColumn Column: 1 StoreTo: %FreeRow%
    LOOP FROM 2 TO %FreeRow% - 1 STEP 1
        Excel.ReadFromExcel.ReadCell Column: 1 Row: %CurrentItem% StoreTo: %Name%
        Excel.ReadFromExcel.ReadCell Column: 2 Row: %CurrentItem% StoreTo: %Email%
        IF %Name% = $'''''' THEN
            Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Empty name at row %CurrentItem%''' Icon: Display.Icon.Warning Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False
        ELSE
            Variables.SetVariable Name: %Output% Value: %Name% + $''' <''' + %Email% + $'''>'''
            Text.WriteToFile TextToWrite: %Output% FilePath: $'''C:\\output\\contacts.txt''' AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: Append
        END
    END
    Excel.SaveAs Document: %ExcelInstance% FilePath: $'''C:\\output\\backup.xlsx'''
ON BLOCK ERROR
    Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Excel error occurred''' Icon: Display.Icon.Error Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False
END
Excel.CloseExcel SaveChanges: False
#EndRegion
#Region "FormatReport"
Excel.LaunchExcel Visible: True LoadAddIns: False
    Excel.SetCellFormat CellFormat: Excel.CellFormat.Bold Column: 1 Row: 1
    Excel.SetCellFormat CellFormat: Excel.CellFormat.Bold Column: 2 Row: 1
    Variables.SetVariable Name: %Header% Value: $'''Name,Email'''
    Text.WriteToFile TextToWrite: %Header% FilePath: $'''C:\\output\\header.txt''' AppendNewLine: False IfFileExists: Overwrite
Excel.CloseExcel SaveChanges: True
#EndRegion
